g.text: pi tool call over the gateway MCP route
pi configured with only the gateway MCP URL (pi mcp add)
pi called the tool with the canary argument
cmd: just pi-mcp-check | pass: prints 'pi mcp list: rc=0 tools=[...alpha_ping...]'
cmd: just pi-mcp-check | pass: prints 'pi: tool_calls=1 args={message: canary-...} received_pong=True'
cmd: just pi-mcp-check | pass: prints 'gateway: tools/call records=1 tool=[alpha_ping] arguments=[{...canary...}]'
cmd: just pi-mcp-check | pass: prints 'PASS pi-mcp' and podman ps -a lists no wattson-gw-pimcp
